original.statement: A new stable API version external-secrets.io/v1 of ExternalSecret is now available.

decision.reason: The renders show external-secrets.io/v1 ExternalSecret was absent in 0.15.0 and is served in 0.16.0 [ev-09b8aa472138][ev-9e957ffda511][ev-b80f52507eed], so no environment can already be using v1 before the upgrade. That means a version-scoped condition would match no one. The new version is added to the existing externalsecrets.external-secrets.io CRD, and v1beta1 stops being the storage version [ev-10a72c580d6b], so the environments this addition touches are the ones that use the ExternalSecret kind in any version. Because the fixed consequence is none/informational, this condition creates no mandatory work. No canonical exposure shape exists for an added GVK (validator inconclusive), so confidence is low.
